pages.title: Fortune Coin and Ring
pages.text: Protective accessories use their designated slots rather than normal armor slots.$(br2)$(bold)Fortune Guarding Coin$(): consumes itself to protect against an eligible misfortune.$(br2)$(bold)Shieldbreaker Ring$(): equip in a ring slot and strike a blocking enemy in melee to trigger its shield-breaking effect.

pages.title: Blood Fang Pendant
pages.text: Equip the Blood Fang Pendant in a necklace slot. Blood-demon cultivators or living corpses carrying blood or blood crystals can receive automatic replenishment when Blood Qi or grudge is low.$(br2)Equipping it does not create resources without suitable blood materials and the required cultivation state.

pages.title: Enlightenment Leaf
pages.text: Equip the Enlightenment Leaf in a charm slot and practice a cultivation method through meditation or a spell to benefit from its proficiency bonus.$(br2)Change accessories to suit enemies, cultivation, and current goals. Their activation conditions differ; consult their tooltips before use.
